items.headline: Coastal Flood Statement issued October 8 at 4:39PM EDT until October 9 at 10:00PM EDT by NWS Miami FL
items.description:
* WHAT...Isolated minor coastal flooding.

* WHERE...Coastal Collier County and Mainland Monroe.

* WHEN...Through Friday evening.

* IMPACTS...Some water on low lying roads and property.
items.instruction: Do not drive through flooded roadways.
